editorial.intro: 这项研究利用仿真或三维场景生成，为具身智能提供训练、测试和安全验证所需的可控环境。
editorial.why_it_matters: 高质量仿真能够降低真实机器人试错成本，但关键在于生成环境是否保留了任务和物理约束。
editorial.watch_next: 继续核对仿真与真实环境之间的差距，以及是否能复现到真实机器人。

evidence.title: How NVIDIA Factory Operations Blueprint Coordinates AI Agents to Investigate Production Issues
evidence.excerpt: Robotics English 中文 How NVIDIA Factory Operations Blueprint Coordinates AI Agents to Investigate Production Issues Nov 04, 2026 By Samuel Ochoa and Carlos Garcia-Sierra Discuss (0) L T F R E AI-Generated Summary The NVIDIA Factory Operations Blueprint (FOX) provides a reference architecture for building a factory manager agent that connects existing factory data and tools, configures specialized agents, and defines which decisions require operator review. The Factory Manager Agent uses an LLM such as NVIDIA Nemotron , the NemoClaw agent harness, and NVIDIA OpenShell to interpret tasks, manage persistent memory, and enforce access policies. Specialist agents including a Visual Inspection Agent that calls NVIDIA Cosmos, a Fleet Management Agent demonstrated with NVIDIA Isaac Sim and ROS 2, and a Root Cause Analysis Agent that uses Kumo Anomaly for time-series analysis coordinate to inspect defects, arrange rework, and investigate causes. In an SMT assembly line reference example, the system follows an AOI alert through secondary inspection, robot transport to rework, and root cause analysis that produces a PDF report with evidence and recommended corrective action.
